_about: Per-mission activation-load budgets, in the bytes/4 tokens scripts/validate.py's transitive_load() measures (2026-10-23 review, section 5: one catalog-wide cap bounded only the heaviest mission, so the other 21 could grow by thousands of tokens unseen). validate.py fails a mission whose load exceeds its budget, a mission with no budget, a budget naming no mission, a budget above MISSION_MAX_LOAD_TOKENS, and a budget more than max_slack above the measured load (a shrink is banked by lowering the budget, never kept as silent headroom). A budget is the measured load rounded up to the next step. Raising one is a hand edit whose commit says why.
